big: The Nifty stands at 24,000. The one-month future trades at 24,060. Why is the future above the spot price? Because holding the asset until expiry has a cost. That cost explains the gap.

lines: Why does the future cost more than the index today?

Futures price sits near spot plus the cost of carry, mostly funding cost less dividends. The gap, called basis, narrows and reaches zero at expiry. Index futures end with cash settlement, not delivery of shares.
